headline: EvoOntology reports gains from queryable semantic state and a regression-blocking evolution gate
summary: EvoOntology presents an MCP-served ontology that data agents can query at runtime and refine through typed edits admitted only after paired evaluation on held-out tasks. On three data-agent benchmarks, the authors report improvements over no-ontology baselines across multiple backbones. On DDR-Bench, the paper reports a mean Trajectory-Wise gain of 12.3 percentage points from the initial ontology and another 7.7 points after self-evolution; on BIRD, initial ontology improves execution accuracy by 5.1 points and evolution adds 3.7. In an ablation averaged across four backbones, removing the paired gate lowers the final DDR-Bench score from 89.5 to 78.3 (-11.2 points), the largest drop among four loop components. These are author-reported results from a single preprint; no independent reproduction is reported here.
